title: Power Apps Foundation — Day 1: How Apps Solve Problems
subtitle: A business application does not exist to show off code or fancy screens. An application exists for one single purpose: to move a real human problem toward a useful result.

title: Power Apps Foundation — Day 2: Instructions & Sequence
subtitle: Every digital app executes human commands in a strict order. Explore why computers never guess, how sequence prevents disaster, and how Power Apps chains actions.

title: Power Apps Foundation — Day 3: Data (What an App Knows & Remembers)
subtitle: Instructions cannot operate in a vacuum. Every calculation, filter, and button click relies on stored values. Master the four building blocks of digital business data.

title: Power Apps Foundation — Day 4: Questions, Conditions, True & False
subtitle: An app cannot make decisions in the dark. Before it can choose an action, it must ask a question about its data. That question is a Condition , and its only possible answer is True or False .

title: Power Apps Foundation — Day 5: Decisions (IF / THEN / ELSE)
subtitle: Yesterday, conditions gave our app the ability to discover True and False . Today, the If() function turns that verdict into active business behavior—opening a fork in the road so the app does the right thing at the right moment.

title: Power Apps Foundation — Day 6: Combining Conditions (AND / OR / NOT)
subtitle: Yesterday, If() gave our app the ability to choose a path based on a single condition. Today, we discover that real business decisions require multi-gate checkpoints: combining several True/False conditions into a single unified verdict.

title: Power Apps Foundation — Day 7: From Real Problem to App Opportunity
subtitle: In Days 1–6, you mastered data, conditions, and logic gates. Today, we step back to understand where those requirements come from. An app is not just buttons on a screen—it is an operational tool designed to solve a specific human friction point.

title: Power Apps Foundation — Day 8: Process, Workflow, Status & Decision
subtitle: Connecting Actions and Decisions Across People and States in Microsoft Power Apps

title: Power Apps Foundation — Day 9: Model a Complete Business Flow
subtitle: Connecting problem, request, review, decision, execution, and sign-off into one continuous operational flow with zero dropped batons.

title: Power Apps Foundation — Day 10: Records and Tables: Storing Many Cases
subtitle: How apps organize repeated workplace cases into structured, queryable data storage without overwriting past history.

title: Power Apps Foundation — Day 11: Design Data from the Process
subtitle: Every column in your table must answer a real question needed by the workflow. Never design data from guesswork.

title: Power Apps Foundation — Day 12: From Process + Data to App Screens
heroTitle: From Process + Data to App Screens
subtitle: Screens are the user-facing steps of your business process. A screen is a dedicated workstation that exposes only the exact data and actions required for one human task.

title: Power Apps Foundation — Day 13: Power Apps Studio: Map Design to Controls
heroTitle: Power Apps Studio: Mapping Paper Design to Canvas Controls
subtitle: Moving from physical wireframes to real software: Turning sketched boxes into controls, dials into properties, and tree views into industrial workstations.

title: Day 14: Controls: Input, Action, Output | Microsoft Power Apps Foundation
subtitle: Every control on your canvas has an irreplaceable job. Master the input-process-output triad: Labels display facts, Inputs collect data, Dropdowns enforce clean choices, and Buttons trigger actions.
chain: Real Problem ➔ Process ➔ Data ➔ UI / Controls ➔ Action ➔ Storage ➔ Feedback ➔ Test

title: Day 15: Navigation: Connect Screens into a Flow | Microsoft Power Apps Foundation
heroTitle: Navigation: Connect Screens into a Flow
subtitle: Transform isolated screens into the seamless business journey designed on paper. Master the navigation chain: User Action → OnSelect → Navigate() / Back() → Target Screen, ensuring operators never feel trapped or submit duplicate records.
chain: Real Problem ➔ Process ➔ Data ➔ UI / Screens ➔ Action (Navigate) ➔ Storage ➔ Feedback (Confirmation) ➔ Test

title: Day 16: Properties & Formulas: How Controls Behave | Microsoft Power Apps Foundation
subtitle: A formula calculates what a property should be or what an action should do. Master the dynamic reactivity of Power Apps: when user input changes, dependent properties recalculate instantaneously like a living spreadsheet.
chain: Real Problem ➔ Process ➔ Data ➔ UI / Controls ➔ Logic / Formulas ➔ Action ➔ Storage ➔ Feedback ➔ Test

title: Day 17: Conditions + IF in Power Fx: Validation | Microsoft Power Apps Foundation
heroTitle: Conditions + IF in Power Fx: Validation
subtitle: Reconnect logic foundation to real Power Apps behavior. Discover how True/False decisions act as an intelligent security gatekeeper, stopping blank "Ghost Tickets" before they ever pollute your database.
chain: Real Problem ➔ Process ➔ Data ➔ UI / Screen ➔ Logic / Decision ➔ Action (Notify) ➔ Storage ➔ Feedback ➔ Test

title: Day 18: Variables: Let the App Remember | Microsoft Power Apps Foundation
subtitle: Give your Power Apps short-term memory! Discover how variables capture values from user actions, hold them securely in temporary memory, and reuse them across screens and calculations.
chain: Real Problem ➔ Process ➔ Data ➔ UI / Screen ➔ Logic / Decision ➔ Action (Set) ➔ App Memory ➔ Storage ➔ Feedback ➔ Test

title: Day 19: SharePoint List: Persistent Business Data | Microsoft Power Apps Foundation
subtitle: Graduate from temporary app memory to permanent cloud storage. Learn how SharePoint lists serve as the indestructible steel filing cabinet that preserves business records across shifts, users, and app restarts.
chain: Real Problem ➔ Process ➔ Data ➔ UI / Screen ➔ Logic / Decision ➔ Action ➔ Storage (SharePoint) ➔ Feedback ➔ Test

title: Day 21: Gallery: Read and Select Records | Microsoft Power Apps Foundation
subtitle: A single label can only show one text value. Today we unlock repeating UI architecture: a Gallery translates an entire table of cloud records into a browsable, interactive list using a single master template.
chain: Real Problem ➔ Process ➔ Data ➔ UI / Screen [GALLERY] ➔ Logic/Decision ➔ Action ➔ Storage [CONNECTED] ➔ Feedback ➔ Test

subtitle: A Gallery browses hundreds of records, but an Edit Form dives into the details. Today we master form architecture: connecting a single selected business record to structured, editable DataCards ready for inspection and update.
